given_when_then.given: A Delivery Proof is successfully recorded for an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The system processes the settlement event
given_when_then.then: The system generates a Financial Transaction Record with correct split amounts for all parties

given_when_then.given: The Delivery Proof is missing or invalid for an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to process the settlement event
given_when_then.then: The system prevents financial distribution and flags the Order Request for manual review

given_when_then.when: The system processes the settlement event
given_when_then.then: Transactions involving high-risk indicators must be paused for manual verification before settlement

given_when_then.when: The system calculates the net settlement amount
given_when_then.then: The sum of all distributed amounts must equal the total value of the Financial Transaction Record

success_criteria: A Financial Transaction Record is generated for every completed delivery regardless of outcome
The sum of all distributed amounts must equal the total value of the Financial Transaction Record
Settlement calculations strictly adhere to the terms defined in the Store Partner Agreement
Financial distribution is blocked if a valid Delivery Proof is not recorded
Transactions with high-risk indicators are paused for manual verification before settlement
